Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original strict simple GTA III (2001 original PC) HUD icon sprite sheet for Klad Theft Hummer: Коростишів. This is tiny old game HUD art, drawn with a blunt black brush and just TWO solid color fills, not polished detailed game concept art. Reduce every subject to a compact hard recognizable silhouette, 2–5 major interior black shapes at most. Thick BLACK contour of exactly consistent weight across all icons, angular restrained drawing, firm straight edges. NO surface textures, grain, wear speckles, scratches, engravings, fine hatching, realistic shading, gradients, gloss, bevels, soft lighting, 3D volume, tiny mechanical features, decorative embellishment or fine highlights. Only the fixed limited palette stated below, large flat areas with one hard shadow shape. Use no more detail than an original 32px GTA III weapon icon; at 32px each icon should remain almost unchanged in meaning. Center each whole silhouette inside its invisible cell with at least 12% empty padding. EXACT square 1024×1024 transparent PNG, invisible 4×4 grid, 256×256 cell. Entirely transparent unused cells. No background, floor, cast shadow, checkerboard, border, drawn grid, captions, numbers, lettering or watermark. Strict occupied-cell positions, left to right then top to bottom; never reflow only occupied cells to fill the image.

Row 3 cell 4 EMPTY. Row 4 all EMPTY. Scale each icon to about 75% of cell along longest dimension. Firm, restrained, crude but readable original GTA III weapon icons.
